svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Red port / green starboard on the nacelle OUTBOARD faces
Procedure pending the Rev U re-audit of guide Phases 4-11 (graphical-build-guide/WBS.md 1.5.6).
This card shows the Rev U architecture only; follow the authority documents named below.
Mount red on the port and green on the starboard nacelle outboard face.
Route the nav-light wires through the internal cableway; nothing protrudes.
WS2812B LED rings are retired; do not fit them.
No flash rate is mandated for Part 107; 60 FPM is a design convention (REFERENCES.md disposition).
SOURCE: airframe/wings-nacelles/WBS.md nav-light items; REFERENCES.md REF-FAA-002/003
